articles.title: A West Point cadet drugged his girlfriend to force an unwanted abortion. Then he went to grad school
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — A onetime West Point cadet drugged his then-girlfriend in her barracks room, administered abortion pills to her against her will and caused a miscarriage. Then he went on to study at two Ivy League universities, starting at one of them after he pleaded guilty to assault, according to court records and a new lawsuit.

articles.title: Man charged in 401 crash in Mississauga that left 2 dead in July, OPP says
articles.summary: A Mississauga man has been charged in a crash on Highway 401 that left two people dead and three injured in July, Ontario Provincial Police say.

articles.title: Inside man or scapegoat? Defence, prosecutors make closing submissions in Pearson airport gold heist trial
articles.summary: Was a then-Air Canada employee an inside man who helped carry out one of the biggest gold heists in Canadian history, or a scapegoat exploited by a longtime friend? Those were the two competing scenarios presented to a Brampton, Ont., court Monday as prosecutors and defence lawyers made their closing submissions in the trial of Parmpal Sidhu.

articles.title: Man faces impaired driving charges after fiery crash in Whitby leaves woman dead
articles.summary: A driver is facing impaired driving charges after a fiery collision on Highway 401 on Sunday left a woman dead, police say.

articles.title: Garden suite built under new Toronto city planning rules upsets neighbours
articles.summary: Fed up with what she calls a violation of her backyard privacy, an East York woman is going public with her campaign to have new garden suites limited to just one storey.

articles.title: Carney calls December byelection for Scarborough North, 5 other ridings in Canada
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney has called byelections for a total of six ridings located in Saskatchewan, Ontario and Quebec that will give the Liberals a chance to strengthen their thin majority in the House of Commons.

articles.title: Woman dies in hospital after stabbing in North York, police investigate as homicide
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a homicide in North York after a woman died in hospital with stab wounds on Friday.

articles.title: Pickering city council returning to in-person meetings after year-long virtual shift due to threats
articles.summary: Pickering city council is set to officially return to in-person meetings in its newly renovated council chambers on Nov. 16. after conducting municipal business online for nearly two years.
